_: AI Debt Tracker, WEEK 4. Every number here is transcribed from the author's own saved results as published in pantry/*.svg and in narration_script.md's source table. Each bar's geometry in those SVGs was recomputed as a ratio and had to agree with its printed fraction before the value was accepted. Nothing in this file is estimated, rounded for the frame, or typed from memory.

reader.check_set_when: fixed in the design in week 1, before any of the three methods ran

methods.label: The event reader
methods.what: code picks passages, the model points, code parses

methods.label: B2 one model call
methods.what: the model types every value itself

reader.extra_means: an instrument reported that the filing does not announce
reader.dev_set: developed only on the week 1 bake-off documents, which are not in this set — three rounds, then frozen, then run once on the 24

grounding._geom: shared linear scale 1.1023 px per copy. 227 -> 250.2, 3 -> 3.3, 24 -> 26.5.
grounding.rule: Every value must be found, word for word, in the passage the model cites
grounding.passage: …closed its underwritten public offering of €1,500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 2.500% notes due 2029…

refused_kinds.what: the word "null" written out as text

grounding.null_note: a bookkeeping bug with no effect on any score, fixed in code afterwards
grounding.trade: A refused value is missing, not wrong. Code parses every number that survives.

miss.why: blank even where the year's "20" should be, so last week's fix for blank covers never fired — and "Preferred Stock" in its contents read as a share sale

false_alarm_note.what: an earnings release that does announce a $150m Macquarie financing — the label missed it
false_alarm_note.rule: labels are not changed after a run

duplicate.what: one document was in both labelled sets, filed twice under two co-issuers

handcheck.drawn_how: drawn by seed, chosen before reading

defects.what: total debt built from half a pair
one bond tagged under two names
a range of years read as one bond
graded bond by bond with no bond to grade

handcheck.left_open: Defects are logged for next week, not fixed against these.

truthcheck._: the machine check on the labels — not a person reading them
truthcheck.labeller_note: a different model from the one being tested, but not a person
truthcheck.written_when: before any of the three methods ran; the label file has the same hash before and after

bonds.what: labelled new bonds with a coupon and a year appear in the next quarterly report's XBRL with the same coupon and year

principal.what: the labelled principal agrees where the key states one in the same currency

reader_defects_open._: FRICTIONAL.md names three and gives no defect ids for them, unlike P41-P46. None is invented here, and no beat shows an id for these.
reader_defects_open.why_open: Fixing them against the 24 filings would turn the evaluation set into a calibration set, so they go to week 5.
items: the currency sign rewritten while claiming to copy
a "$500 million term loan facility" sentence scored below the passage threshold, so one filing had no passages at all
a blank preliminary prospectus, where the model listed the company's table of existing notes as if they were new
